# Encryption Layer (@vida/core/encryption) — Vida Platform

# Auto-read by Claude when editing files in this directory.

# Generated by /layer-docs · refresh: /layer-docs --refresh

## What this layer is

The zero-knowledge crypto core: vault key derivation + field encrypt/decrypt, SRP password-less auth, in-memory key lifecycle, and sharing prep (ADR-001 §6).

## Pattern in use

- Built on `libsodium-wrappers-sumo`. Call `initVault()` (awaits `sodium.ready`) once at startup; every crypto fn guards with `assertReady()`.
- Key hierarchy: password → Argon2id Master Key → BLAKE2b-256(Master ‖ Account Key) = Vault Key → XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypts all fields.
- The Vault Key exists **in memory only** while unlocked; `key-management.ts` is the singleton owning unlock→use→lock→wipe (`zeroKey`) and status listeners.
- SRP is fully client-side (`secure-remote-password/client`): the server only ever stores salt + verifier, never the password.

## Imports

- Types from `@vida/types`; intra-layer via relative `./vault` etc. `vault.ts` is the dependency root — others build on it.

## Do not

- Never log, persist, or transmit the Vault Key, Master Key, or password — only opaque encrypted fields and SRP proofs leave this layer.

## Key files

- vault.ts: key derivation, `encryptField`/`decryptField`, `hashContent`, `initVault`.
- key-management.ts: in-memory key store, lock/unlock lifecycle, status events.
- srp.ts: registration + login challenge/verify request builders.
